## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changes.

## UI consistency (when UI changes)

- [ ] Uses approved components from UI-STANDARDS.json.
- [ ] Any new pattern/variant/package is registered and included for tech-lead review.
- [ ] No new raw controls, copied widgets, or widened legacy exceptions.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, labels, pending/empty/error states, mobile and zoom reviewed.
- [ ] Visual evidence attached for meaningful layout changes.

## Validation

Record applicable type, lint/UI standards, unit and browser checks, plus remaining limitations.
